notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to black is at least three.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Abhorrent Overlord.
description:
Activate Abhorrent Overlord by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Abhorrent Overlord trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Harpy creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Abhorrent Overlord.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Harpys, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
